title: Annotate an axis bracket — annotate_axis_bracket
text: Draws one brackets along floating axis line. bracket spans min(breaks) max(breaks) caps every break value. Requires coord_cartesian(clip = "").

title: ggscribe 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-07 Improved ticks bracket linewidth. Made bracket corners join neatly. Supported normalised coordinates (e.g. xintercept = (0.5)). Supported vectorised style arguments. Removed position argument axis_*. Removed minor argument axis_ticks. Added layout argument support panel annotations facet plots. Added smart hjust vjust defaults axis_text. Removed theme_sec_axis_text. Improved panel_shade fill default. Refactored code.
